distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) treated the historical Taiwan attribution as doubtful. The species is known from Japan and Korea; the Taiwan record derived from two Shiraki specimens and was excluded from the accepted checklist. No confirmed Taiwan occurrence is promoted.

host_note: No host evidence is reported for this doubtful Taiwan record; no host is promoted from Beaver & Liu (2010).
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Coccotrypes nubilus (Blandford, 1894).
